title: adminwarps
description: A Warp System That Is For Admins With The Permission f1gpukmc.adminwarps
body:
Admin Warps (Runs Off F1GPUKMc.adminwarps Luck Perms Permission)

/createadminwarp (Name) - Creates The Warp
/adminwarp (Name) - Shows The Admin Warps
/deleteadminwarp (Name) - Deletes The Warp
/adminwarplist- Shows All Of The Set Up Warps
